sources.title: DeepBrainz-R1-4B - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: DeepBrainz-R1-4B DeepBrainz-R1-4B is a compact, high-performance reasoning model engineered by DeepBrainz AI & Labs. It is part of the DeepBrainz-R1 Series, designed to deliver frontier-class reasoning capabilities in cost-effective parameter sizes. This variant offers an extended context window (up to 32,768 tokens), making it suitable for medium-length document and code analysis.
